verses.pali: “Dvinnaṁ dhammānaṁ, bhikkhave, atitto appaṭivāno mātugāmo kālaṁ karoti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, ladies die without getting enough of two things.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ dhammānaṁ atitto appaṭivāno mātugāmo kālaṁ karotī”ti.
verses.english: Females die without getting enough of these two things.”
